summary: Build a practical AI governance framework, operating model, and controls. Learn with templates, exercises, and executive-ready outputs.
lede: AI governance framework training is for professionals responsible for AI risk, data, technology, or oversight who need to put policies into practice. It covers governance roles and decision rights, mapping AI risks to controls, and setting model intake, approval, and lifecycle monitoring processes, including checks for drift, bias, and performance. Participants also practice documenting control evidence and reporting governance status.
audienceIntro: This AI governance framework course is designed for professionals who need to turn AI policy ambition into day-to-day oversight, control design, and reporting. You will benefit most if you work close to AI risk, data, technology, legal review, or operating model design.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of AI use cases, business processes, or technology delivery environments. Prior exposure to risk management, data governance, compliance, internal audit, enterprise architecture, or product governance will help, but no programming is required. The course is suitable for intermediate professionals who need to define, review, or operationalize AI governance rather than engineer models from scratch.
